annotations.title: Find a calm idea for a tricky moment

description: Suggests Breatho & Friends calming helpers for a child's tricky moment or big feeling, such as bedtime, the dentist, haircuts, school drop-off, loud noises, waiting, worries or big angry feelings. Returns the matching moment and 1-3 simple calming moves to try.

moment.description: The situation or feeling in the parent's own words, e.g. 'won't go to bed' or 'scared of the dentist'.

name: find_calm_idea
title: Find a calm idea for a tricky moment
